Mutable Instruments Rings and stmlib source
============================================

This directory contains the Rings DSP and stmlib source needed by
`dpt/DPT.multimode` for the Bearamin Resonator modes.

Source checkout:

- Repository: https://github.com/pichenettes/eurorack
- eurorack commit: 08460a69a7e1f7a81c5a2abcc7189c9a6b7208d4
- stmlib commit: e3bd7c9cc00e4364166f9905c0509b6ffd0535ec

The copied files retain their original MIT license headers.
